1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `checkDigit` property (integer 0–9) to the `Owner` schema, so `OwnerDto` is generated with the field.

2. **`src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/CheckDigit.java`** (new) — a stateless, seed-independent helper `CheckDigit.of(String customerCode)` that applies the standard Luhn algorithm over the decimal digits of the customer code (ignoring the hyphen/letter separators), returning `null` when the code is absent. Its logic mirrors the test's `luhn(...)` exactly.

3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added an `@Mapping` expression wiring `checkDigit` to `CheckDigit.of(owner.getCustomerCode())`, so it appears on both the create and GET owner responses.

Test results: `./mvnw test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (the new `coreCheckDigitIsLuhnOfCustomerCode` acceptance test, the only test class in the project, passes).
